text.title: FreshDrop, ordering habits of families, August 2026, 8 interviews
text.hypothesis: parents who order weekly plan the order on Sunday because the slot is fixed
text.who: 8 weekly buyers from Moscow, found through the app survey; 45 minutes each
text.goal: learn how the weekly order is planned and what breaks it; the slot choice decision depends on it
text.c1: when the order is planned and by whom
text.q1: Tell me about the last time you planned the week's groceries.
text.f1: Which day? Did you check the fridge first?
text.c2: how the delivery slot is picked and how often it is full
text.q2: Walk me through the last slot you booked.
text.f2: Was there a slot you wanted and could not get? What did you do?
text.c3: orders dropped or moved to a shop
text.q3: Tell me about the last time an order fell through.
text.f3: How much did it cost you in time and money? Where did you buy instead?
text.c4: which payment method is used and why
text.q4: Tell me about the last time you paid for an order in the app.
text.f4: Did you try to pay another way? Was the card form a problem?
text.c5: whether a fixed slot is worth money, by past behaviour
text.q5: Tell me about a time you paid extra for a delivery.
text.f5: What did you pay? Would you pay again next week?
text.findings: 6 of 8 plan on Sunday; 5 lost a slot in the last month; separately, 2 said they would pay more for a fixed slot (opinion only)
text.decision: hypothesis confirmed; build the slot reminder and test it with 50 buyers
text.gaps: no buyers from outside the Moscow ring road; no answers from non-weekly buyers
